description: Dashboard for disk information based on S.M.A.R.T. data.

targets.expr: floor((smartctl_raw_read_error_rate{ host=~"$host", device=~"$device" } and smartctl_raw_read_error_rate{device=~"^ata-ST.*" } )/4294967296) or smartctl_raw_read_error_rate{ host=~"$host", device=~"$device" }
floor((smartctl_seek_error_rate{ host=~"$host", device=~"$device" } and smartctl_seek_error_rate{device=~"^ata-ST.*" } )/4294967296) or smartctl_seek_error_rate{ host=~"$host", device=~"$device" }

title: S.M.A.R.T.
